summary.text: Wisdom refinement formation is Fang Yuan's Gu formation that uses the light of wisdom with Woman's Heart and Unravel Mystery as cores to refine other people's Immortal Gu.

claims.text: Facing the problem of refining Immortal Gu that belong to others, Fang Yuan names a Gu formation he had already thought of wisdom refinement formation. He had robbed many sword path Immortal Gu from immortal zombie Bo Qing and used the light of wisdom and star thoughts to deduce the formation. It is built with the light of wisdom, Woman’s Heart and Unravel Mystery as cores, and large numbers of supplementary mortal Gu. Change Soul, Sword Eyebrows, Flying Sword, Sword Escape, Wave Sword, and rank eight Wisdom Sword are all refined with its help. When wisdom Gu does not acknowledge him and he cannot use light of wisdom, he cannot arrange the formation.

Fang Yuan builds another immortal formation that uses wisdom refinement formation as foundation with many wisdom path Immortal Gu, making a stronger version that still uses the light of wisdom as core. The original formation uses light of wisdom with Woman’s Heart and Unravel Mystery to refine other Immortal Gu, and works even better when the other person’s will is present. He had used Mo Yao’s fake will to refine Immortal Gu from Bo Qing’s immortal zombie body, including change soul Immortal Gu, which mattered in the Battle of Yi Tian Mountain. Fang Yuan improves his formation path and wisdom path methods, and the formation’s rank nine Wisdom Gu easily suppresses the rank seven Immortal Gu it refines.
Fang Yuan designed most of a list of Gu formations that includes wisdom refinement formation, modifying and setting them up personally step by step.

Inside the sovereign immortal aperture, subordinates finish an immortal formation floating in Mini Yellow Heaven. Fang Yuan’s time path clone confirms it is the wisdom refinement formation, built with light of wisdom along with Woman’s Heart and Unravel Mystery to refine other Immortal Gu, stronger when the other person’s will is present. Initially he used Mo Yao’s fake will to refine Bo Qing’s Immortal Gu, including change soul Immortal Gu, which let him snatch sovereign immortal fetus Gu at Yi Tian Mountain. In a previous life he modified the formation heavily; in this life a small tweak is enough. Great thief ghost hand tosses stolen Immortal Gu into the formation, which envelops them in bright golden light as light of wisdom gathers and rapidly refines them for Fang Yuan.
